newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Strathmore to distribute assets.
newsitem.headline: Strathmore to distribute assets.

text.p: Investment company Strathmore Group Ltd said on Friday it intended to distribute to its shareholders some NZ$10 million cash and all of its shares in Wellington Drive Technologies and in CES Communications.
The distribution will be via a pro rata share buyback offer, for up to 38 million shares.

Strathmore said valuing the Wellington Drive shareholding at current market value on Sharemart (36 cents per share) and valuing CES at the value of the recent placement of new shares to Strathmore placed a value on the buyback offer of $17 million or about 45 cps.

If approved and the offer accepted by all shareholders, about 85 percent of Strathmore assets will be distributed to its shareholders, and about 75 percent of Strathmore's outstanding shares will be cancelled.

However, it said its reduced size would be more appropriate to merge with some existing operating entity, "and accordingly a wider range of opportunities are likely to present themselves". The company will retain about $3.5 million of tax losses.
The distribution of cash and shares is likely to occur in December.

Shareholders accepting the offer will end up with their proportion of cash distributed (value per cancelled share = 26.3c), their pro rata entitlement proportion of Wellington Drive (value per cancelled share = 13c) and their pro rata proportion of CES (value per cancelled share = 5.5c).
They will also retain about a quarter of their current holding in Strathmore.
Strathmore sait it would remain an investment company, with cash backing about 25 cps.
